URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cp9ezldrkkgo
NOTE: BBC (20 Jul 2026) — analysis of Burnham cost-of-living options; policies to be announced Tuesday (first full day). Personal allowance "look at" ahead of autumn Budget; £3 bus-fare cap; council homes; sticks to no rise in income tax/NI/VAT.
Burnham says he will "look at" raising the tax-free personal allowance. £3 bus fare cap (England outside London) in place until March, voluntary. Labour manifesto pledge to cut household energy bills by £300 by 2030 under scrutiny. Burnham to The Times: without "sufficient homes for people that they can afford, you chase rent through the benefits system in the private rented sector".
